description:
Submit a challenge against a PASS verdict during the challenge window.

Two-step process:
1. Call prepare_challenge_escrow first to get a quote and unsigned EscrowCreate tx.
2. Sign and submit the EscrowCreate (fee goes to worker address as escrow).
3. Call this tool with the resulting tx hash.

Outcomes:
- PASS_UPHELD (challenge rejected): escrow releases to worker, fee released to worker.
- PASS_OVERTURNED (challenge upheld, CancelAfter ≥ 24h): vault enters REMEDY status, fee is REFUNDABLE.
- REVIEW_INCONCLUSIVE (Pro unavailable): escrow releases to worker, fee is REFUNDABLE.

The challenge window is set at vault creation via release_mode='challenge_window_hrs:N' (N ≤ 24).
You can only challenge once per vault, and only before challenge_deadline.

challenger_address.description: Your XRPL wallet address (r...) — must match the buyer on this vault.
challenger_address.title: Challenger XRPL Address

criteria_ids.description: Optional: one or more criterion IDs you believe the work failed. If omitted, the full verdict is reviewed.
criteria_ids.title: Criterion IDs to Dispute

escrow_id.description: The receipt code for the escrow whose PASS verdict you want to dispute.
escrow_id.title: Escrow ID

fee_tx_hash.description: 64-char XRPL tx hash of the EscrowCreate you signed and submitted (from the unsigned_tx in the quote).
fee_tx_hash.title: Challenge Fee EscrowCreate Hash

quote_id.description: The quote ID from prepare_challenge_escrow. Contains the fee amount and condition.
quote_id.title: Challenge Quote ID

reason.description: Optional: explain specifically why the work does not satisfy the listed criteria.
reason.title: Reason for Challenge
